title: One organization shows three names (Branding, the Organization record, the product chrome) and two timezones (Edit Organization, Localization) — one place for each, or say which wins (hotcrm#2194 T2-U20, R2-T2-U10)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 同一个组织在品牌设置、组织记录、产品界面里有三个名字；「编辑组织」又有一个独立的时区，与本地化设置的默认时区重复，没说哪个生效。
- **要做：** 原定并入 #24766，但该卡在裁决前已按 B′ 关闭，没有处理这件事。组织名称和时区各只在一处编辑，或在页面上写明哪个生效。
- **完成标准：** 管理员能在一个地方改组织名，且知道时区以哪个为准。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U20 and R2-T2-U10** (round 2 folded R2-T2-U10 into it). It was ruled as a fold into #24766. That card closed `completed` on 2026-10-20T21:48Z, before the ruling, under ruling B′, which scoped the Branding keys but did not unify the organization's name or timezone, so the item is filed here (see *Why*). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Round 1 (T2-U20):** Branding's "Organization name" read "ObjectStack", the Organization record "Default Organization", and the product chrome "ObjectOS". Three names for one thing. Evidence: objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-20; [`25-config-branding.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/25-config-branding.png), [`sweep-08-organization.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/sweep-08-organization.png).
- **Round 2 (R2-T2-U10):** the Edit Organization dialog has no Name field (the organization cannot be renamed there) but has its own Timezone, which duplicates Localization's Default timezone, with no rule shown. Evidence: objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-10; [`08-people-organization-edit.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/08-people-organization-edit.png).
- **What #24766 landed (B′):** under `single`, Branding's `workspace_name` drives the runtime product name; under a wall, the Branding page is withheld. #24987 (closed) fixed Company → Legal name's help that pointed at Branding. The organization record's own name and the two timezones were not in scope.

## Landing

- `sys_organization` (its name and timezone fields; `plugin-auth` / `platform-objects`), the settings namespaces for Branding, Company and Localization (`service-settings`), and the Edit Organization action.
- The dev measures which value each surface reads (the product chrome, the org switcher, mail, date rendering) and proposes the single home for the name and for the timezone in the claim. If unifying them changes what a stored value means, that is a contract question and goes back to the maintainer, ⛔ not decided in the PR.

## Done when

- The organization's display name is edited in one place, and every other surface that shows it reads that value or says where it is set.
- The organization's timezone has one home, or each of the two pages states which one wins.
- Pins on the reading chain.

**Size:** S–M.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `organization name`, `branding`, `timezone`, `edit organization`, `sys_organization`. 1 open hit: #25249 (settings without an organization source), not on point; the closed #24766, #24987, #24887 and #25264 are the branding work described above. **New.**
